Privacy Policy
Version v2026-10-20 · Effective October 20, 2026
At Ocoya, accessible from https://www.ocoya.com , one of our main priorities is the privacy of our visitors. This Privacy Policy document contains types of information that is collected and recorded by Ocoya and how we use it. If you have additional questions or require more information about our Privacy Policy, do not hesitate to contact us.
1. General data protection regulation (GDPR)
We are a Data Controller of your information. UAB Ocoya legal basis for collecting and using the personal information described in this Privacy Policy depends on the Personal Information we collect and the specific context in which we collect the information:
UAB Ocoya needs to perform a contract with you
You have given UAB Ocoya permission to do so
Processing your personal information is in UAB Ocoya legitimate interests
UAB Ocoya needs to comply with the law
UAB Ocoya will retain your personal information only for as long as is necessary for the purposes set out in this Privacy Policy. We will retain and use your information to the extent necessary to comply with our legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our policies. If you are a resident of the European Economic Area (EEA), you have certain data protection rights. If you wish to be informed what Personal Information we hold about you and if you want it to be removed from our systems, please contact us. In certain circumstances, you have the following data protection rights:
The right to access, update or to delete the information we have on you
The right of rectification
The right to object
The right of restriction
The right to data portability
The right to withdraw consent
2. Data security and protection
Ocoya maintains appropriate technical and organizational safeguards designed to protect personal and sensitive data from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, alteration, loss, or destruction. These safeguards include encryption during transmission using HTTPS/TLS, encryption at rest, role-based and least-privilege access controls, authentication controls, security monitoring and logging, vulnerability management, secure backups, and incident-response procedures.
Access to personal and sensitive data is limited to authorized personnel, service providers, and systems that require it to operate, secure, and maintain Ocoya’s services. Service providers that process such data on our behalf are subject to appropriate confidentiality and data-protection obligations.
We periodically review our security controls and retain personal and sensitive data only for as long as necessary to provide our services, fulfill the purposes described in this Privacy Policy, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. When data is no longer required, we delete or anonymize it in accordance with our retention procedures.
3. Google user data
Ocoya only uses Google user data to provide and improve user-facing features requested by you, including connecting a Google or YouTube account, displaying connected account information, and publishing or managing content on your behalf.
We do not sell Google user data. We do not share, transfer, or disclose Google user data to third parties, including service providers, advertising platforms, data brokers, or information resellers.
We may disclose Google user data only to Google APIs and Google services as necessary to complete actions requested by you, or when required to comply with applicable law, regulation, legal process, or enforceable governmental request.
Ocoya’s use and transfer of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
4. Log files
Ocoya follows a standard procedure of using log files. These files log visitors when they visit websites. All hosting companies do this and a part of hosting services’ analytics. The information collected by log files include internet protocol (IP) addresses, browser type, Internet Service Provider (ISP), date and time stamp, referring/exit pages, and possibly the number of clicks. These are not linked to any information that is personally identifiable. The purpose of the information is for analyzing trends, administering the site, tracking users’ movement on the website, and gathering demographic information.
5. Cookies and web beacons
Like any other website, Ocoya uses ‘cookies’. These cookies are used to store information including visitors’ preferences, and the pages on the website that the visitor accessed or visited. The information is used to optimize the users’ experience by customizing our web page content based on visitors’ browser type and/or other information. For more general information on cookies, please read our Cookie Policy.
6. Privacy policies
You may consult this list to find the Privacy Policy for each of the advertising partners of Ocoya. Third-party ad servers or ad networks uses technologies like cookies, JavaScript, or Web Beacons that are used in their respective advertisements and links that appear on Ocoya, which are sent directly to users’ browser. They automatically receive your IP address when this occurs. These technologies are used to measure the effectiveness of their advertising campaigns and/or to personalize the advertising content that you see on websites that you visit. Note that Ocoya has no access to or control over these cookies that are used by third-party advertisers.
7. Third-party privacy policies
Ocoya’s Privacy Policy does not apply to other advertisers or websites. Thus, we are advising you to consult the respective Privacy Policies of these third-party ad servers for more detailed information. It may include their practices and instructions about how to opt-out of certain options. You can choose to disable cookies through your individual browser options. To know more detailed information about cookie management with specific web browsers, it can be found at the browsers’ respective websites.
8. Children’s information
Another part of our priority is adding protection for children while using the internet. We encourage parents and guardians to observe, participate in, and/or monitor and guide their online activity. Ocoya does not knowingly collect any Personal Identifiable Information from children under the age of 13. If you think that your child provided this kind of information on our website, we strongly encourage you to contact us immediately and we will do our best efforts to promptly remove such information from our records.
9. Online privacy policy only
Our Privacy Policy applies only to our online activities and is valid for visitors to our website with regards to the information that they shared and/or collect in Ocoya. This policy is not applicable to any information collected offline or via channels other than this website.
10. Data deletion request
If you wish to request the deletion of your personal data from our systems, you can refer to our Help Center. Alternatively, please follow these steps:
Step 1: Submit Your Request. Send an email to our support team at support@ocoya.com with the subject line clearly stating: “Data Deletion Request - [Your Account Email]”. Be sure to include your account details in the email body to help us quickly process your request. Alternatively, you can initiate your request through our live chat, available on our website.
Step 2: Confirmation. Our support team will respond to confirm receipt of your request and may verify your identity to ensure the security of your data.
Step 3: Data Deletion. Once confirmed, your data will be promptly deleted from our systems. You’ll receive a final confirmation once your request has been successfully completed. For any additional assistance, please contact support@ocoya.com or speak with our team through live chat.
For any additional assistance, please contact us at support@ocoya.com or through our live chat.
11. Consent
By using our website, you hereby consent to our Privacy Policy and agree to its terms.
12. Contact us
If you have any questions about these Terms, please contact us at support@ocoya.com .

Questions answered FAQ
Your most important questions before committing — answered here.
Do you have a free trial? + Yes! We offer a 7-day free trial of any paid plan, giving you full access to all features. Starting the trial requires a payment card, but nothing is charged during the 7 days.
What happens at the end of the 7-day trial? + Unless you cancel before the trial ends, it converts automatically into the paid plan you picked and the first monthly or yearly payment is charged that day. You can cancel any time during the trial in Settings → Billing and you won't be charged.
Can I change my plan after subscribing? + Yes, you can upgrade, downgrade, or switch between monthly and yearly billing at any time from your account settings. Changes are prorated automatically.
Do you offer a discount to non-profit organizations and charities? + Yes — reach out to our support team with proof of non-profit status and we'll set you up with a discounted rate.
Do you charge Value-Added Tax (VAT) to customers? + Prices are shown excluding VAT. VAT is added where required by local regulations, based on your billing country, and the total including VAT is shown at checkout before you confirm payment.
What are the credits? + Credits are used for AI generation, automation runs and analytics exports. Each plan includes a monthly allowance — 300 on Starter, 1,500 on Team, 5,000 on Agency — and it resets every month.
How much cheaper is yearly? + Yearly billing gives you two months free — you pay ten months for twelve. Starter is $290 a year instead of $348, Team is $790 instead of $948, and Agency is $1,990 instead of $2,388.
What counts as a channel? + Each connected account — one Instagram profile, one Facebook Page, one LinkedIn Page — counts as one channel. The limit is shared across all the brands in your account.
Can I run more than one brand on a single plan? + Yes. Channels and credits are pooled across every brand in your account, so agencies can run multiple clients without paying per brand.
